<!-- Code generated by xgen. DO NOT EDIT. -->
<!-- Source: xgen/screens/src/authoring/blocks/navigation.ts -->
<!--
  A footer with the brand, a tagline, groups of links and the copyright. Axes: layout (columns: brand above,
  equal columns per group, row: the brand, the group names and the copyright in one row), signup mode (none,
  first: a sign-up above the links), status mode (none, show: a live status pill), density. The live status
  itself is a port contract.
-->
<script lang="ts">
import type { FooterSignup, FooterStatus } from "./sitemap-footer.types";
import type { MegaGroup } from "./mega-menu.types";

export type SitemapFooterProps = {
  label: string;
  brand: string;
  tagline: string;
  copyright: string;
  groups: MegaGroup[];
  signup?: FooterSignup;
  status?: FooterStatus;
  id?: string;
  layout?: "columns" | "row" | "card";
  density?: "default" | "compact";
};
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import Block from "../primitives/block/block.vue";
import Box from "../primitives/box/box.vue";
import Button from "../primitives/button/button.vue";
import Container from "../primitives/container/container.vue";
import Form from "../primitives/form/form.vue";
import Group from "../primitives/group/group.vue";
import Input from "../primitives/input/input.vue";
import Label from "../primitives/label/label.vue";
import Link from "../primitives/link/link.vue";
import Stack from "../primitives/stack/stack.vue";
import Text from "../primitives/text/text.vue";
import Title from "../primitives/title/title.vue";
import FooterCard from "../components/footer-card.vue";
import FooterColumns from "../components/footer-columns.vue";
import Pill from "../components/pill.vue";
import { cn, tpl } from "../utils";

const {
  label,
  brand,
  tagline,
  copyright,
  groups,
  signup,
  status,
  id = "footer",
  layout = "columns",
  density = "default",
} = defineProps<SitemapFooterProps>();
</script>

<template>
  <FooterCard v-if="((layout as string) === 'card')" :label="label" :brand="brand" :groups="groups" />
  <Block
    v-else
    tag="footer"
    class="mt-12 border-t border-border"
    data-testid="site-footer"
    :data-layout="layout"
  >
    <Container
      :class="cn(
        'mx-auto w-full max-w-6xl px-4',
        'flex flex-col gap-8',
        (((density as string) === 'compact') ? 'py-6' : 'py-12')
      )"
      data-slot="container"
    >
      <Stack v-if="(signup?.mode === 'first')" gap="4" class="max-w-md" data-testid="signup">
        <Title :as="3" size="xl" weight="bold">
          {{ signup?.title }}
        </Title>
        <Form :class="cn('w-full max-w-md', (false ? 'mx-auto' : ''))" data-testid="email-form">
          <Label :for="tpl('{0}-email', id)" class="sr-only">
            {{ signup?.label }}
          </Label>
          <Group gap="2" align="start" class="w-full flex-wrap">
            <Input type="email" name="email" class="min-w-0 flex-1" :id="tpl('{0}-email', id)" data-testid="field" />
            <Button variant="default" size="default" type="button" data-testid="submit">
              {{ signup?.submit }}
            </Button>
          </Group>
        </Form>
      </Stack>
      <Box
        v-if="((layout as string) === 'columns')"
        class="flex flex-col gap-8 md:flex-row md:items-start md:gap-12"
        data-slot="footer-top"
      >
        <Stack gap="2" class="md:w-64 md:shrink-0">
          <Text size="xl" weight="bold">
            {{ brand }}
          </Text>
          <Text size="sm" class="text-muted-foreground">
            {{ tagline }}
          </Text>
        </Stack>
        <Box class="min-w-0 flex-1">
          <FooterColumns :label="label" :groups="groups" />
        </Box>
      </Box>
      <Group v-else gap="6" align="center" justify="between" class="flex-wrap">
        <Text size="base" weight="bold">
          {{ brand }}
        </Text>
        <Block tag="nav" :aria-label="label">
          <Group gap="4" class="flex-wrap">
            <Link v-for="g in groups" :key="g.id" href="#/" variant="default" class="text-sm" data-testid="group">
              {{ g.title }}
            </Link>
          </Group>
        </Block>
      </Group>
      <Group gap="4" align="center" justify="between" class="flex-wrap border-t border-border pt-6">
        <Text size="sm" class="text-muted-foreground">
          {{ copyright }}
        </Text>
        <Pill v-if="(status?.mode === 'show')" tone="green" icon="circle-check">
          {{ status?.label }}
        </Pill>
      </Group>
    </Container>
  </Block>
</template>
